recipes.name: Chicken and chickpea curry with rice
recipes.method:
1. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Chop the onion, crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
2. Cook the rice as the packet says.
3. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 8 minutes, until soft and golden. Add the cumin seeds, garlic and ginger and stir for a minute, then the turmeric, garam masala and chilli powder for 30 seconds.
4. Add the chicken and cook until sealed all over.
5. Add the tomatoes, breaking them up, and the chickpeas. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and the chicken has no pink left; add a splash of water if it gets dry.
6. Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
7. Divide between containers. Cool quickly (within an hour, as cooked rice left out can make you ill) and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne with brown rice
recipes.method:
1. Chop the onion, deseed and chop the pepper and crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the kidney beans.
2. Cook the brown rice as the packet says.
3. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion and pepper for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, chilli powder and oregano and stir for a minute.
4. Add the mince and cook, breaking it up, until browned all over.
5. Stir in the tomatoes, tomato purée, crumbled stock cube, kidney beans and a mug of water. Simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and the mince has no pink left.
6. Divide between containers. Cool quickly (within an hour, as cooked rice left out can make you ill) and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Wholewheat spaghetti bolognese
recipes.method:
1. Finely chop the onion, carrot and celery, slice the mushrooms and crush the garlic.
2. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the mushrooms and garlic and cook for 3 minutes more.
3. Add the mince and cook, breaking it up, until browned all over.
4. Stir in the tomatoes, tomato purée, oregano, black pepper and half a mug of water. Simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and the mince has no pink left.
5. Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti as the packet says and drain it. Toss it with the sauce, or keep them apart if you prefer.
6. Divide between containers. Cool quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Red lentil and vegetable soup
recipes.method:
1. Chop the onion, carrots and celery, crush the garlic and rinse the lentils.
2. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion, carrots and celery for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and cumin and stir for a minute.
3. Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft.
4. Blend until smooth, or leave it chunky, and season with black pepper.
5. Divide between containers. Cool quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

ingredients.name: Stock cubes, chicken, made up with water

recipes.name: Overnight oats with yogurt and berries
recipes.method:
1. Mix the oats, milk, yogurt and honey in a bowl or a container for each portion.
2. Cover and leave in the fridge overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
3. Top with the blueberries just before eating. Keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.name: Salmon, new potato and broccoli traybake
recipes.method:
1. Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan, gas 6). Halve any large potatoes and cut the broccoli into small florets.
2. Toss the potatoes with half the oil, spread over a large roasting tin and roast for 20 minutes.
3. Add the broccoli and the salmon, toss the broccoli with the rest of the oil and roast for 12 to 15 minutes more, until the potatoes are tender and the salmon flakes easily.
4. Squeeze over the lemon juice and season with black pepper.
5. Divide between containers. Cool quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Chicken and vegetable noodle stir-fry
recipes.method:
1. Cut the chicken into thin strips. Deseed and slice the pepper, cut the broccoli into small florets, slice the spring onions, crush the garlic and grate the ginger.
2. Cook the noodles as the packet says, drain, and toss with a little of the oil.
3. Heat the rest of the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden and with no pink left.
4. Add the pepper, broccoli, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, until just tender.
5. Add the noodles and soy sauce and toss until hot. Scatter over the spring onions.
6. Divide between containers. Cool quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Spinach, mushroom and cheese omelette
recipes.method:
1. Slice the mushrooms and chop the tomato. Beat the eggs.
2. Heat the oil in a small non-stick frying pan and cook the mushrooms for 3 minutes. Add the spinach and tomato and cook until the spinach wilts.
3. Pour in the eggs and cook gently, drawing the edges into the middle, until almost set.
4. Scatter over the cheese, fold in half and eat straight away.

recipes.name: Greek-style chicken and rice bowl
recipes.method:
1. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and toss with half the lemon juice, the oregano and half the oil.
2. Cook the rice as the packet says.
3. Heat the rest of the oil in a large frying pan and cook the chicken for 8 to 10 minutes, turning now and then, until golden and with no pink left.
4. Chop the cucumber and tomatoes and crumble the feta. Stir the rest of the lemon juice into the yogurt.
5. Divide the rice and chicken between containers, with the salad, feta and yogurt in separate pots so they stay fresh. Cool the rice and chicken quickly (within an hour, as cooked rice left out can make you ill) and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat the rice and chicken until piping hot.

recipes.name: Chickpea, sweet potato and spinach curry
recipes.method:
1. Peel the sweet potato and cut it into small chunks. Chop the onion, crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
2. Cook the brown rice as the packet says.
3. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 8 minutes, until soft and golden. Add the cumin seeds, garlic and ginger and stir for a minute, then the turmeric and garam masala for 30 seconds.
4. Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sweet potato is tender.
5. Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
6. Divide between containers. Cool quickly (within an hour, as cooked rice left out can make you ill) and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Egg, bean and pepper breakfast burritos
recipes.method:
1. Deseed and dice the pepper, slice the spring onions and drain and rinse the beans. Beat the eggs with the paprika.
2. Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan and cook the pepper for 4 minutes, until soft. Add the beans and spring onions and warm through.
3. Pour in the eggs and stir gently over a low heat until the eggs are just set. Take off the heat.
4. Warm the tortillas, then divide the filling between them, scatter over the grated cheese, fold in the ends and roll up.
5. Eat one now if you like. Cool the rest quickly, wrap each one and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Baked oats with apple and cinnamon
recipes.method:
1. Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, gas 5). Core and chop the apples.
2. Beat the eggs with the milk, yogurt, honey and cinnamon, then stir in the oats and most of the apple.
3. Pour into a baking dish, scatter over the rest of the apple and bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until set and golden.
4. Cut into portions. Cool quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days. Eat cold, or reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Lentil shepherd's pie
recipes.method:
1. Rinse the lentils. Chop the onion, carrots and celery and slice the mushrooms. Peel the potatoes and cut them into chunks.
2. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion, carrots and celery for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the mushrooms and herbs and cook for 3 minutes.
3. Add the lentils, tomatoes, tomato purée and stock. Simmer for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft and the sauce is thick.
4. Meanwhile, boil the potatoes for 15 to 20 minutes until tender, drain and mash with the milk.
5. Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan, gas 6). Spoon the lentils into a baking dish, top with the mash and grated cheese and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.
6. Divide between containers. Cool quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Pork and pepper stir-fry with rice
recipes.method:
1. Cut the pork into thin strips. Deseed and slice the peppers, cut the broccoli into small florets, slice the spring onions, crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Mix the soy sauce, honey and vinegar.
2. Cook the rice as the packet says.
3. Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat and stir-fry the pork for 4 to 5 minutes, until browned and the pork has no pink left. Lift it out.
4. Stir-fry the peppers, broccoli, garlic and ginger for 3 to 4 minutes, until just tender.
5. Return the pork, add the sauce and toss for a minute until glossy and hot. Scatter over the spring onions.
6. Divide between containers. Cool quickly (within an hour, as cooked rice left out can make you ill) and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Prawn, pea and tomato pasta
recipes.method:
1. Chop the onion and crush the garlic.
2. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and chilli powder and stir for a minute.
3. Add the tomatoes, breaking them up, and simmer for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the pasta as the packet says, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, then drain.
4. Add the prawns to the sauce and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until they are pink all the way through.
5. Stir in the pasta, peas and lemon juice.
6. Divide between containers. Cool quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Cod, chickpea and tomato stew with couscous
recipes.method:
1. Chop the onion, deseed and slice the pepper and crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Cut the cod into large chunks.
2. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion and pepper for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and paprika and stir for a minute.
3. Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Nestle the cod into the sauce, cover and cook gently for 6 to 8 minutes, until the cod flakes easily. Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then the lemon juice.
5. Meanwhile, put the couscous in a bowl, pour over boiling water to just cover, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
6. Divide between containers. Cool quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.

recipes.name: Halloumi, chickpea and roast vegetable couscous
recipes.method:
1. Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan, gas 6). Slice the courgette, deseed and chop the pepper and cut the onion into wedges. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
2. Toss the vegetables and chickpeas with most of the oil and the cumin and roast for 25 minutes, until tender and starting to char.
3. Meanwhile, put the couscous in a bowl, pour over boiling water to just cover, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
4. Slice the halloumi and fry it in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes a side, until golden.
5. Stir the vegetables and lemon juice through the couscous and top with the halloumi.
6. Divide between containers. Cool quickly and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.
